user.title: Prerequisites

sip.title: Intercom
sip.description: Extensions of the door station and the tablet. The list comes from sip-core and the Asterisk integration; custom values are allowed. The state sensors are derived from them.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: How does the integration detect a ring, and where do the snapshot and the recording stream come from?

sensors.title: State sensors
sensors.description: These sensors of the Asterisk integration were not found automatically for extensions {ext_door} and {ext_tablet}. Select them or leave them empty; without the door station state sensor a recording only stops after the maximum length.

house.title: House
house.description: Alarm panel and door lock appear in the card; both are optional and can be changed later in the options. mailbox, ansage and freizeichen are created below the base folder.

data.ignore_stream: Ignore the stream error and create anyway

error.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg or ffprobe is missing on this system.
error.dir_failed: The base folder cannot be created or written.
error.stream_failed: The stream does not respond. Check the address or deliberately ignore the error.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Intercom can be configured.
abort.asterisk_missing: The Asterisk integration (service asterisk.send_action) was not found. It is required, see README.

data.idle_state: Idle state of the door station

move.title: Change folder
move.description: The base folder changes from {alt} to {neu}. The old folder holds {messages} messages, {announcements} announcements and {ringback} ringback files. With the switch on they are moved to the new folder; files with the same name in the target are left untouched. Afterwards the integration reloads and reads the folders.

data.move_files: Move files to the new folder

error.move_failed: Moving failed, the base folder was not changed. Check the target folder and permissions.

delete_message.name: Delete message
delete_message.description: Deletes a mailbox entry including its clip and thumbnail.

mark_message_seen.name: Mark message as seen
mark_message_seen.description: Marks a mailbox entry as seen.

mark_all_seen.name: Mark all messages as seen
mark_all_seen.description: Marks all mailbox entries as seen.

activate_announcement.name: Activate announcement
activate_announcement.description: Makes the named announcement the active one.

start_recording.name: Start recording
start_recording.description: Starts a manual recording of the door station stream.

rescan.name: Rescan folders
rescan.description: Reads the mailbox, announcement, ringback and ringtone folders again.

asterisk_sync.name: Sync Asterisk
asterisk_sync.description: Writes all settings into the Asterisk database again.
